environment.description: Node.js 18 application deployed on an EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2. The application runs as the 'app' user with standard filesystem access. No reverse proxy or WAF in front. The server is directly exposed on port 3000 via a security group allowing inbound TCP/3000 from 0.0.0.0/0. The filesystem contains /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, application secrets in /opt/app/.env, and AWS credentials in /home/app/.aws/credentials. SameSite cookie attribute is not set (defaults to None in older browsers).
